title: Degraded availability for GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages and Webhooks
excerpt: GitHub's Status Page - Degraded availability for GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages and Webhooks.
content_html:
Resolved

This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

Posted Oct 19, 2026 - 16:56 UTC

Monitoring

Actions, Pages and Webhooks are operating normally.

Posted Oct 19, 2026 - 16:56 UTC

Update

We’re seeing recovery following mitigation and are continuing to monitor.

Customers may still experience delays in GitHub Actions workflow status updates, GitHub Pages deployments, and check and workflow webhook events generated by Actions runs.

Posted Oct 19, 2026 - 16:30 UTC

Update

We’re are currently investigating degraded availability affecting GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages and Webhooks.

Customers may experience delays in workflow processing, site builds and webhook delivery.

Posted Oct 19, 2026 - 15:56 UTC

Update

Webhooks is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Oct 19, 2026 - 15:50 UTC

Investigating

We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Actions and Pages

Posted Oct 19, 2026 - 15:49 UTC

This incident affected: Webhooks, Actions, and Pages.
